name: Тренажер зв’язок
description:
In this lesson, you are going to practice pinning. You will get miscelaneous puzzles from previous lessons.

If you want to practise a bit before trying, repeat the lesson(s) that you find difficult.

Start right away? Click on Play now. Good luck!

texts: Combine a discovered attack with a pin party. Pinned pawns can't defend well.
